column1: # Stage S10 H3b, fourth Mission Creator crate: the Arsenal (the per-slot loadout editor tab, its
# pure loadout core, its document writes, the panels drawn around a slot's loadout and the 3D
# paper doll host) becomes crates/frontend/workspaces/mission_creator_arsenal. The folder becomes
# the crate's `src`, its module tree `lib.rs`, and its README the source tree README; the feature
# docs move to their mirror under documentation/crates/frontend/workspaces/mission_creator_arsenal.
# The prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to the moved folder and one `mission_creator_arsenal::`
# row scoped to the app's source.
